body.statement: For every \(x\), \(h\), and \(\omega\), write \(u=u_\omega(x)\) and \(v=v_\omega(x)\). The bump normalization and perturbation constant give \(|u|\le a_h\le c_\circ\le1/16\) and \(|v|\le b_h\le c_\circ\le1/16\). The four entries of each table in \(\mathrm{def{:}fuzzy\mbox{-}mixtures}\) sum to one and are at least \(\{1-|u|-|v|-|uv|\}/4>0\). The null table satisfies \(p_\omega=(1+r_Au)(1+s_Yv)/4\), so \(P_\omega(Y=y_+\mid A=1,X=x)=P_\omega(Y=y_+\mid A=0,X=x)=(1+v)/2\) and \(U_{P_\omega}(x)=0\). The alternative table has \(Q_\omega(A=1\mid X=x)=(1+u)/2\) and \[Q_\omega(Y=y_+\mid A=1,X=x)=\frac{1+u-v+uv}{2(1+u)},\qquad Q_\omega(Y=y_+\mid A=0,X=x)=\frac{1-u-v-uv}{2(1-u)},\] whence \[Q_\omega(Y=y_+\mid A=1,X=x)-Q_\omega(Y=y_+\mid A=0,X=x)=\frac{2uv}{1-u^2},\qquad U_{Q_\omega}(x)=\frac{2u_\omega(x)v_\omega(x)}{1-u_\omega(x)^2}b_Y.\] Disjoint bump supports and the shared sign vector give \(u_\omega v_\omega=a_hb_h\sum_jg_{h,j}^2\) and \(u_\omega^2=a_h^2\sum_jg_{h,j}^2\), so \(U_{Q_\omega}\) is independent of \(\omega\), nonnegative in its scalar coefficient, and nonzero. Moreover, for each record cell \(r_A,s_Y,x\), \[2^{-K_h}\sum_\omega p_\omega(r_A,s_Y\mid x)=2^{-K_h}\sum_\omega q_\omega(r_A,s_Y\mid x)=\frac{1+r_As_Ya_hb_h\sum_jg_{h,j}(x)^2}{4}.\] Thus the uniform one-record mixtures coincide exactly. If the constant Fourier weight of \(k\) is \(a_0>0\), then \(\|\Psi(Q_\omega)\|_{\mathcal H}\ge2\sqrt{a_0}c_Xc_ga_hb_h\|b_Y\|_{\mathcal H_Y}>0\).
body.justification: The displayed cell algebra rules out the erroneous factorization of the alternative and certifies both the exact null and the nonzero SCoDiTE signal before any information bound is invoked.
body.gap: The scalar fuzzy construction of Kennedy et al. does not record the full SCoDiTE cell table or the kernel-embedded contrast generated by its nonfactorizing alternative.
body.consumer: The identities provide the auditable null and signal calculations used by every rough-regime lower bound in the proposal.
